Title: Rajesh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rajesh - 35 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 65 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rajesh stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rajesh sips red wine.]

Rajesh: "Oh wow!"

[Rajesh drinks a beer.]

Rajesh: "What happened?"

[Rajesh staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Hema: "Rajesh, are you okay?"

[Rajesh and Mother clink their glasses.]

Hema: "That was such a fun day!"
